name: F1 Calendar
author: github.com/MarkVebeer
description: F1 Calendar: a Formula 1 race calendar with a web frontend and Discord notifications, running on Bun. Pushes to the Git branch are deployed automatically with no downtime: the new commit is built and tested next to the live site and traffic switches over once it is healthy. Put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front of the allocation and set PUBLIC_URL to that address.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# F1 Calendar installation script
# Server files: /mnt/server
# This only fetches the code. deploy/supervisor.js builds, tests and starts a release on first start
# and keeps it up to date afterwards, so a reinstall is only needed to reset the checkout.
set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/MarkVebeer/F1-Calendar.git}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
DATA="${DATA_DIR:-./data}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating existing F1 Calendar checkout from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"
    # Full history: the footer build number is the commit count.
    git fetch --unshallow origin "${BRANCH}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch origin "${BRANCH}"
    git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
    echo "Cloning F1 Calendar from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    rm -rf /tmp/f1-calendar
    git clone --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /tmp/f1-calendar
    cp -a /tmp/f1-calendar/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/f1-calendar
fi

# The data folder holds the SQLite databases. It is git ignored, so updates never touch it.
mkdir -p "${DATA}"
for db in f1calendar*.db; do
    if [ -e "${db}" ] && [ ! -e "${DATA}/${db}" ]; then
        echo "Moving ${db} into ${DATA}"
        mv "${db}" "${DATA}/${db}"
    fi
done

# Releases are built in releases/<commit>; dependencies and builds in the root are no longer used.
rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules client/dist package-lock.json client/package-lock.json

test -f deploy/supervisor.js

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "F1 Calendar installation completed"
echo "Press Start: the first start builds and tests the app, which takes a minute or two."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The public address of the site without a trailing slash, for example https://f1.example.com. Also used for Discord links and the OAuth callback.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Username for the admin area. Cannot be "admin".

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the admin area. Synced from here on every start.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Application ID from the Discord Developer Portal. Leave empty to run without Discord.

variables.name: Discord Client Secret
variables.description: OAuth2 client secret from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Meteoblue API Key
variables.description: Needed for weather forecasts and notifications.

variables.name: Discord Activity Type
variables.description: Activity type shown on the bot.

variables.name: Discord Activity Text
variables.description: Activity text shown on the bot.

variables.name: Website Button Label
variables.description: Label of the website button on Discord notifications.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Folder for the databases, backups and generated tracks, relative to the server root. Reinstalling leaves it untouched.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Repository to install and update from.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to install from and deploy automatically on every push.

variables.name: Automatic Deploys
variables.description: Deploy every push to the Git branch without downtime. Set to false to stay on the installed commit.

variables.name: Deploy Webhook Secret
variables.description: Secret of the GitHub webhook pointing at PUBLIC_URL/__deploy/github, so pushes deploy within seconds. Leave empty to rely on polling only.

variables.name: Deploy Poll Interval
variables.description: How often, in seconds, to check the branch for new commits in case a webhook is missed. 0 turns polling off.
